subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term. 

TACKLE : TCCMLG :: JACKET : JCCMEV :: NEPTUNE : ?
solution:
**Explanation:**

According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The alphabets at even places are increased to 2 positional values. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4519557180c514707046d8afc2a050c84068b4bed0ff5f3636104e4f1856b372.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ea5dda59965c10fd5647c20d423c7f23dbd5963be6e014f581b52f9572f3f89.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74372795e2636872f3fb445d1b8d3b2246ee4b890b8507eaab1f677a5dcad126.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 4.**
